title: compact-token-gauges-latency-tiles-prototype
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: deliver a compact per-route and per-model performance panel focused on fast-glance operational signals for token-level cost, latency percentiles, and throughput. This ticket delivers high-fidelity Figma prototypes, a lightweight interaction spec for drilldowns, and chart rendering guidelines for engineering (quantiles, micro-gauges, sparkbars, and stacked token-cost waterfalls). The UI is intended for narrow-width side panels and embeddable microcards in the route list.
acceptance_criteria: Figma prototypes include small/medium/large density variants and responsive rules
Chart spec doc lists data inputs, aggregation windows, and recommended visual encodings for each metric
Engineering receives a vetted interaction spec for hover/drill behavior and an accessibility checklist (color contrast, keyboard nav)
Hand-off artifacts (Figma + Confluence + example JSON payload) are uploaded and linked in comments
PM sign-off on prioritization and sample query cost before dev kickoff
decisions: Use micro-gauges for 95th latency plus a numeric median token-latency to maximize scanability
Represent throughput as rate-per-second sparkbar with a 1m and 5m aggregation toggle rather than a heavy timeseries by default
Token-cost shown as a stacked small waterfall: model compute vs. prefix cache benefit vs. tokenization overhead
Avoid full waterfall with absolute cost numbers in the compact card; surface delta compared to route baseline on expand
Quantile shading (50/90/95) will be rendered using three-tier opacity instead of separate lines to reduce ink in small widths
